property_summary: For any caller with sufficient balance and MinSum, if the ETH transfer in Collect fails (e.g., the caller is a contract whose receive/fallback reverts), the reference C must revert atomically and leave balances[caller] and address(c).balance unchanged; the mutant ignores the failed transfer, decrements balances[caller] and keeps the ETH, so a diverging observable state appears for some input.
change_summary: Ignore the success flag from the external call and always log the collection so state observation diverges when the callee fails.
